Bench: Debangsu Basak 19.01.2023 Serial no. 08 [Dd] (Anticipatory bail) (Rejected) CRM (A) 248 of 2023 In re : An Application for Anticipatory Bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Dalkhola Police Station Case No. 230 of 2022 dated 29.07.2022 under Sections 498A/326/307/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
-And- In the matter of : Dipak Mondal @ Dipak Kumar Mondal & Anr.
... ...Petitioners
... For the Petitioners Mr. Swapan Banerjee, Mr. Suman De, Advocates ...
...For the State Petitioners pray for anticipatory bail.
Learned advocate appearing for the petitioners submits that the petitioners were falsely implicated
The materials in the case diary suggest that one injured suffered grievous hurt.
Such injured implicates the petitioners in the assault.
Considering the gravity of the offence and the involvement of the petitioners therein, we are unable to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners.
Prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners is rejected.
